subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared announce-completion classifier as the durable boundary for disabling tools and skipping human restart recovery on `announce:v1:*` parent-topic runs?
rationale: The code is bounded and tested, but it intentionally changes both persisted session recovery semantics and the shell/file tool boundary for a cross-session delivery turn.

options.title: Approve Current Boundary
options.body: Accept the `subagent_announce` task-completion classifier plus `announce:v1:*` lifecycle marker as the intended security and session-state boundary for this fix.

options.title: Narrow The Recovery Semantics
options.body: Ask for a smaller adjustment before merge, such as a different terminal status or additional mixed-run recovery coverage, while keeping the tool-free handoff.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a larger redesign of subagent announce delivery ownership rather than this targeted recovery/tool-boundary repair.

recommendation.title: Approve Current Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the `subagent_announce` task-completion classifier plus `announce:v1:*` lifecycle marker as the intended security and session-state boundary for this fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places this person closest to the affected agents, gateway recovery, and Codex runtime surfaces.
